post.description: Complete 2FA setup or verify a login challenge.
Rotate a valid refresh session and return a new access token.

Revoke the current refresh session and clear its cookie.

The two-factor trust cookie survives a plain logout; ``forget_browser``
clears it too.

Revoking the session needs the refresh proof, which only the tab that
signed in holds. Without it (another tab, after the first one closed),
the session is left to expire, but this browser still forgets it: the
cookies are cleared all the same. validate_origin keeps other sites from
clearing them.

post.description:
Revoke every access token of this student account.

Student tokens are stateless, so a shared classroom computer would keep a
usable token until it expires. Bumping the generation revokes the account's
tokens on every device, which is the safe side for a shared computer.

Training participation tokens are revoked too, so whoever uses the
computer next cannot go on training as this student. Exam participations
keep theirs: a student who signs out mid-exam signs in again and resumes.

post.description:
End a running or paused class session now, as its timer would.

Its answers are kept and graded; a session with answers can no longer be
cancelled, so this is how a teacher closes one early, for instance when a
student who never handed in holds it open.

schema.title: Response Preview Quiz Api Quizzes  Quiz Id  Preview Get

post.description:
Record the answer on screen for the current question, without moving on.

In an exam the student may go back in, the server holds what the screen
shows: a change to a question, or what is entered when leaving it, is
saved as it is. An empty answer removes the one recorded; the question
then stays within reach as a skipped one.

Leave the current question unanswered and move on.

A skip is no answer: the participant only remembers the question, which
stays within reach. The quiz ends or offers its review as after an answer,
and the session's end stores an empty answer, scoring zero, for each
skipped question still unanswered.
Leave the questions and go back to the summary of the given answers.
Hand in a reviewed paper, which ends the quiz for this participant.
